## Summary

The EP02 Khmer already reads as natural spoken Cambodian: Harin stays dry and short (self `បង` to Woojin, `ចាស ម៉ែ` to her mother), Woojin stays blunt with `ខ្ញុំ`, Mija keeps `អូយ`/`ណា៎`/`~` at the table and switches to polite `ចាស`/`បងសុកគូ` only on the phone, consistent with EP01. Only two lines needed fixing, both small idiom fixes in Mija's table talk (a child "growing taller" and "eat first"). Every clue wording and constraint was kept untouched: P16 `លក់`/`បញ្ចាំ` split, P17–18 `ភ្លាម`, P20 without `ថែម`, P29 `កូនង៉ា`, P51 with `បងសុកគូ…` on its own, P53 `ថែមទៀត?`, P54 `ខ្ញុំជូនតិច…ថែម`, P55/P10/P11 durations, P57 L08, P58 mirroring P42; no `វា`/`ក៏`/`ដែរ`/`អាតូច`/`បំណុល`/`សង`/amounts. Note for script-editor (non-blocking): the editor's note at the end of the script still quotes the old P27 wording `ឡើងខ្ពស់`; the KM line itself is the reference. Round 2 (narrow spelling fix flagged by the EP03 review): P26 conjunction `នឹង` → `និង`; every other `នឹង` in the script means "will" (P20 ×2) and was left untouched, and no other line changed.

## Decisions

Uncertainty resolved automatically (what was unclear, what was chosen, why).

- P15 `បងឃើញនៅក្នុងថតរបស់ពូ`: considered dropping `របស់`, but `ថតពូ` can be misread as "photograph uncle" (`ថត` = to photograph). Kept the original.
- P41 `…ឬមួយប៉ាទៀត?`: the Korean 「혹시 아빠까지?」 leaves open whether Dad also knows or also pays. Kept the compressed Khmer so the ambiguity (and the misdirection toward Dad) stays; adding `ដឹង` would narrow it.
- P48 `ប៉ាក្មេងៗនៅក្នុងផ្ទះ។`: the Korean has an implied "so…"; the plain statement already explains why she stepped outside, so no causal word was added.
- P20 `បងនឹងធ្វើការរោងចក្រច្រើនម៉ោងជាងនេះ`: a shorter "extra hours" phrasing would need `ថែម`/`បន្ថែម`, reserved for the "pay more" chain. Kept.
- Round 2, scope: searched every KM line for `នឹង`. Only P26 uses it as "and"; P20 `បងនឹងធ្វើការ…` and `ប៉ានឹងបាក់ចិត្ត` are future "will" and stay. Not a full re-review; all round-1 decisions and clue wordings kept byte-identical.
- P19 `ដូចណាស់មែនទេ?`: `ដូចបេះបិទ` would be more vivid but is Harin's word in the P18 thought; kept the line distinct.
